Package edu.cnu.mdi.item

Class ItemState

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.item.ItemState
public final class ItemState extends Object
An immutable snapshot of the editable state of an AItem: where it is (focus, path or line), how it is oriented, how it is styled, and any item-specific extras. Undo/redo stores one snapshot before and one after each edit and puts the item back by handing a snapshot to AItem.restoreState(ItemState).

All mutable parts are copied on the way in and on the way out, so a snapshot is unaffected by what happens to the item afterwards.

The extra value carries state specific to an item class, such as an ellipse's width and height. It must be immutable and have value-based equals, for example a record of immutable parts, because sameAs(ItemState) uses it to tell whether an edit changed anything.

    • ItemState

      public ItemState(Point2D.Double focus, double azimuth, Path2D.Double path, Line2D.Double line, IStyled style, Object extra)
      Create a snapshot. The geometry and style arguments are copied.
      Parameters:
      focus - the item's focus, or null
      azimuth - the item's azimuth in degrees
      path - the item's path, or null
      line - the item's line, or null
      style - the item's style, or null if it is not captured
      extra - item-specific immutable state with value equality, or null

      public boolean sameAs(ItemState other)
      Tests whether two snapshots describe exactly the same state. Used to avoid recording an edit that changed nothing, such as a drag that was cancelled or rejected.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
